app.name: qr2g.it
app.tagline: Permanent, QR-friendly short links for public GitHub repositories.

help.title: About qr2g.it
help.intro: qr2g.it creates permanent, QR-friendly short links for public GitHub repositories. The link survives renames, transfers, and archives - once issued, it points to the same repo forever.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1: Paste any public GitHub repository - owner/repo, github.com/owner/repo, or the full URL.
howItWorks.step2: We resolve it to GitHub's stable identity (the repo's GraphQL Node ID) and issue a short slug.
howItWorks.step3: If the repo is renamed or transferred later, the short link follows the new location automatically.

qr.title: QR codes
qr.customize: Customize foreground and background colors, error correction, size, margin, and corner roundness.
qr.export: Export as SVG, PNG, JPG, or BMP. Filenames use the short link.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.note: qr2g.it only links to public repositories. We don't collect personal data.

input.label: Public GitHub repository
input.helper: Accepts owner/repo, github.com/owner/repo, or https://github.com/owner/repo. Public repos only.

errors.invalid_url: That isn't a valid public GitHub repository URL.
errors.repo_private: This repository is private. qr2g.it only links to public repositories.
errors.rate_limited: Daily create limit reached. Try again later.
errors.github_rate_limited: GitHub rate limit reached. Try again shortly.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our end.
